newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: Overnight shelling rocks Congo Republic capital.
newsitem.headline: Overnight shelling rocks Congo Republic capital.

text.p: Automatic weapons fire punctuated by bursts of shelling rocked the Congo Republic capital Brazzaville overnight but stopped after daybreak, residents said.
It was not clear whether supporters of President Pascal Lissouba or his rival and predecessor Denis Sassou Nguesso were to blame, they added.

Indiscriminate artillery and other exchanges between the two sides in the past month have killed hundreds of people in the capital of the former French colony and sent tens of thousands of people fleeing their homes.
